answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. By the thread of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, published publicly on failure. The nadir holds work receipts rather than names, so the nectar of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
